api_set: VM Apps Org - Provisioning Service (published as "VMware Aria Automation Assembler IaaS API")
source_statement: THIS CONTRACT IS DERIVED FROM REFERENCE DOCUMENTATION, NOT FROM A PUBLISHED SPECIFICATION. VCF Automation is the successor to vRealize Automation and Aria Automation and has no entry in the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository (Apache-2.0), and the Broadcom Developer Portal serves no downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger document for this API set. Every path, method, header, query parameter, body field and status code below was transcribed by hand on 2026-08-11 from the human-readable xAPIs reference pages recorded in docs/official_sources.json. Treat it as an accurate reading of that documentation and nothing more: it is not vendor-generated, it is not authoritative, and it is not guaranteed to be complete. Fields the reference pages do not mention are simply unknown, not proven absent. Each section below carries a transcription_status of "literal" (stated on the cited page) or "inferred" (a reasonable reading the page does not state outright).

base_url.description: Scheme and authority of the VCF Automation appliance, with no trailing slash, e.g. https://automation.vcf.example.com. Every operation path below is appended to it verbatim.
base_url.note: The reference pages render a live sandbox appliance hostname in their example URLs. The contract deliberately does not hardcode any host: the client is constructed with a base_url and must contact no other host.

authentication.transcription_status: literal for scheme/in/header_name; inferred for header_value_format
authentication.note: The API Security Schema page states type apiKey, name Authorization, in header. It does not spell out the value format. The "Bearer {access_token}" form is this contract's inference, matching how VCF Automation access tokens are presented elsewhere in the platform. The exact single space between "Bearer" and the token is part of the wire shape the verifier checks.

apiVersion.description: The version of the API in yyyy-MM-dd format (UTC).
apiVersion.wire_rule: Optional on all three operations. When the caller has not configured an apiVersion, the parameter must be absent from the query string entirely. An empty apiVersion= is a different request and is wrong.

Content-Type.applies_to: operations with a request body (createVsphereStorageProfile only)
Content-Type.wire_rule: Must not be sent on the two GET operations, which have no body.

Accept.wire_rule: All three operations return JSON. Sending Accept: application/json is permitted and expected on every request.

error_body.note: Shared by every documented non-2xx response of all three operations. No field is guaranteed present, so a client must not depend on any single one being there.

response_structure.name: Region
response_structure.note: Taken from the response section of the Get Region operation page; no standalone Region data-structure page was fetched, so this list is scoped to what that page shows.

id.description: The ID of the Fabric vSphere Datastore.
The id of this resource instance.

externalId.description: External entity Id on the provider side.

externalRegionId.description: Id of datacenter in which the datastore is present.

cloudAccountIds.description: Set of ids of the cloud accounts this entity belongs to.

name.description: A human-friendly name used as an identifier in APIs that support this option.

defaultItem.description: Indicates if a storage class acts as a default storage class for a disk.

regionId.description: The Id of the region that is associated with the storage class.

supportsEncryption.description: Indicates whether this storage class supports encryption or not.

tags.description: A list of tags that represent the capabilities of this storage class.

datastoreId.description: Id of the vSphere Datastore for placing disk and VM. Deprecated, instead use 'storageProfileAssociations'.

storagePolicyId.description: Id of the vSphere Storage Policy to be applied.

provisioningType.description: Type of provisioning policy for the disk.

limitIops.description: The upper bound for the I/O operations per second allocated for each virtual disk.

diskMode.description: Type of mode for the disk.

diskType.description: Disk types are specified as Standard or First Class.

priority.description: Defines the priority of the storage class with the highest priority being 0. Defaults to 1.

storageFilterType.description: Defines filter type for adding storage objects (data stores) to the storage class. Defaults to INCLUDE_ALL.

tagsToMatch.description: A set of tag keys and optional values to be set on data stores to be included.

computeHostId.description: The compute host Id to be associated with the storage class.

wire_rules.omit_unsupplied: An optional field the caller did not supply must be absent from the JSON object. Sending it as null, as "", as 0, as false or as [] is a different request. The appliance reads an absent field as "leave at the documented default" and a present field as an explicit instruction, so the two are not interchangeable.
wire_rules.falsy_is_not_unset: Presence is decided by whether the caller supplied a value, never by whether that value is truthy. defaultItem is required and must be sent even when it is false. priority must be sent when supplied even when it is 0, which the reference documents as the highest priority and not as an absent value. supportsEncryption must be sent when supplied even when it is false.
wire_rules.no_extra_fields: Only the fields named in required_fields and optional_fields may appear. The client must not invent fields and must not forward the region or datastore objects it read during the precheck.
wire_rules.tag_shape: Each element of tags and tagsToMatch is a Tag object with required key and value, plus an optional id.

201.meaning: Successful operation. The created storage profile is returned in full; no read-back call is needed.

createVsphereStorageProfile.undocumented_statuses_note: The reference page documents only 201, 400 and 403 for this operation. It documents no 404, which is one reason the precheck below cannot be replaced by "post and see what happens": a bad regionId or datastoreId surfaces, if at all, as an opaque 400.

response_structure.name: VsphereStorageProfile
response_structure.note: The response reports externalRegionId and cloudAccountId. It does not echo the regionId that was submitted.

precheck_rule.rationale: This is the contract's own operating rule for safe placement, assembled from three literal facts on the cited pages: a Region carries externalRegionId ("Id of datacenter") and cloudAccountId; a FabricVsphereDatastore carries externalRegionId ("Id of datacenter in which the datastore is present") and cloudAccountIds ("Set of ids of the cloud accounts this entity belongs to"); and createVsphereStorageProfile documents no 404, so it cannot be relied on to reject a region or datastore that does not exist or does not line up. The rule is not printed as a rule on any reference page.
precheck_rule.requirement: createVsphereStorageProfile is mutating and must be gated. The precheck runs first and completely. If any of its conditions fails, no request to createVsphereStorageProfile may be sent, so nothing on the appliance is changed.

steps.condition: The regionId must resolve. A 404 means the region does not exist and the precheck fails.
Runs only when the caller supplied a datastoreId. The datastore must resolve; a 404 means the precheck fails.
steps.note: When no datastoreId is supplied there is nothing to cross-check, and this step is skipped entirely rather than called with an empty id.

steps.condition: Local comparison of the two objects already fetched, with no further calls. The datastore's externalRegionId must equal the region's externalRegionId, i.e. the datastore must sit in the datacenter the region points at. And when the region reports a cloudAccountId, that id must appear in the datastore's cloudAccountIds, i.e. the datastore must be reachable from the region's cloud account. Either comparison failing fails the precheck.

precheck_rule.ordering: Step 1 precedes step 2. A missing region must be reported without a datastore lookup having been attempted.

served_operations_note: The loopback mock in tests/vcfa_mock.py builds its routing table from the operations map above and serves nothing else. Any other method or path receives 501 and is flagged in the request log, so a client straying outside this contract fails the verifier rather than passing quietly.
